quotes.text: Artificial Intelligence (AI).—The agreement provides no less than the fiscal year 2023 enacted level for NIST's ongoing AI research and measurement science efforts and to execute its responsibilities pursuant to Executive Order 14110, ``Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy Development and Use of Artificial Intelligence.'' Within the funds provided, up to $10,000,000 is available for the establishment of a U.S. AI Safety Institute.
Our nuclear innovation is a nation that began with the Manhattan Project, and the next Manhattan Project is clearly AI (Artificial Intelligence).
No way should an algorithm decide if seniors should get the care they need.
